description: Floods in Canada - Cartographic Product Collection is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Collection of flood products for active and past floods throughout Canada as monitored by Natural Resources Canada using satellite imagery for emergency response. This collection of cartographic products regroups flood extent polygons and their associated footprints. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are Services d'urgence, Histoire, Archives, Inondation, Catastrophe naturelle. The portal shows 2023-01-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
